### Adding your own photos

Put your image files in `images/handcrafted/`, then replace the lines above.
Each one follows this pattern:

```
![Your caption here](images/handcrafted/your-file.jpg)
```

Add or remove lines freely — the grid rearranges itself. Change `layout-ncol=3`
to `2` or `4` if you want a different number of columns.
